name: Sweet Heart
source:
Main character is left alone at home during the festivities. He needs to spend these nine days alone. But should he really be alone? It's a great opportunity to find a girlfriend.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-august-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
慶典期間，主角獨自留在家中。接下來九天，他都得這麼過。

但他真的應該一個人嗎？這是尋找女朋友的好機會。

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-august-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
